unread.name: increment counts every call without a reply id
a reply is counted once across local and server signals
empty message id counts like none
set zero or negative removes the entry and keeps order of the rest
set on an existing chat keeps its position
manual unread is exactly one and survives increments until cleared
release keeps the count but drops the manual flag
clear all resets counts, counted replies and manual flags
only the newest 50 counted replies are remembered per chat

sharedSubChat.name: nulls fall back like undefined, zero stays
edit time falls back to updated time
